messages:
emma-finops: Heads up 1 I found three refunds in NetSuite that are 100x the Stripe amount. Stripe shows $12.50 but NS shows $1250. Notable customers impacted.

sam-eng: whoa. any recent deploys to the billing connector or NS schema changes?

levi-billing: we migrated a custom field last week from amount_cents (int) to amount_decimal (string) for better precision. mapping logic was supposed to divide cents by 100 when populating amount_decimal. looks like the migration script updated the schema but the live connector still writes the old cents value into the new field without scaling.

ana-acct: that would blow up AR numbers. we need an emergency reversal for the affected receipts and a corrected posting.

sam-eng: quick mitigation: stop the connector's refund->netsuite path (feature flag off) to avoid new bad posts. I can toggle flag now.

netsuite-sync-bot: Action: feature flag billing.connector.refund_to_ns toggled OFF by sam-eng at 14:02 UTC.

levi-billing: good. next: write a safe backfill that detects refs where ns_amount = stripe_amount * 100 and create reversing JE + repost correct credit memo. We should also add a validator in the connector to assert abs(ns_amount - stripe_amount) < 1.0 or error.

emma-finops: please include the Stripe refund ids in the audit note. Accounting needs those before we touch GL.

sam-eng: patch plan: 1) add guard that converts cents -> dollars correctly when writing to amount_decimal, 2) add unit test covering migration schema, 3) add runtime assertion (fail safe) and telemetry metric 'ns_amount_mismatch'. I'll open PR BR-1217.

levi-billing: I'll prepare the reversals in NS: list of affected refund external_ids, reversing JE template, and a reload job for corrected credit memos. We should tag each corrected memo with "auto-corrected: stripe_refund:rf_..." in memo field.

ana-acct: accounting approves reversals and repost with corrected values. Please include a month-end adjustment note if needed. For transparency, also list which customers were emailed.

netsuite-sync-bot: Created ticket BR-1217: fix cents->decimal mapping; Created DLQ: refund_amount_mismatch entries: 3.

sam-eng: PR opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/621. small change, running tests. After merge I'll run a staging replay of the three events with corrected mapping.

emma-finops: how many customers affected total? we found three but run a 30-day scan for similar mismatches please.

levi-billing: running a quick query now: select refunds where abs(ns_amount - stripe_amount*100) < 1 -> result shows 3 current + 0 historical beyond 7 days. will run full 30-day job and post results.

sam-eng: deploying fix to staging in 20m. We'll keep connector off in prod until validation passes.

emma-finops: thanks. once validated, please execute reversals and reposts in the maintenance window. Also send short customer notices for any ledger changes.

levi-billing: agreed. will coordinate window and post back with reversal IDs and corrected memo ids in this thread.

ana-acct: one more ask: add an integration test that runs a sample Stripe refund through the connector and compares the NS posted amount to expected dollars to prevent regressions.

sam-eng: will add the integration test. thanks for the catch.

emma-finops: great teamwork 1 keep me posted.
